:::{#thm-lempel-ziv-optimality}
#### The Lempel--Ziv code reaches the entropy

Let $X_1, X_2, \ldots$ be [independent](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/independence.html#def-indpt) copies of a [discrete random variable](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/random-variables.html#def-discrete-rv) $X$
that takes a finite number of values,
and let $\entropyf{X}$ be its [entropy](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/expectation.html#def-entropy)
with base-2 [logarithms](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/algebra-exponentials.html#def-logarithm).
Let $\codelenf{x}$ be the number of [bits](entropy.qmd#def-bit) that the [Lempel--Ziv code](#def-lempel-ziv-code) uses for the message $x = (X_1, \ldots, X_n)$.
Then with [probability](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/probability-basics.html#def-probability) one,

$$\lim_{n \to \infty} \frac{\codelenf{x}}{n} = \entropyf{X}.$$

:::

::: {.proof}

@cover2006elements [section 13.5] prove this for more general sources than this one.
The proof is not reproduced here.

:::
